football_evidence.question: Can Texas’ pass rush get to Trinidad Chambliss?
football_evidence.assessment: EdgeDesk’s number is 10.1 points closer to Ole Miss than the line, and EdgeDesk cannot account for most of that: its own breakdown accounts for about 0.0 of the 10.1 points. There is a specific reason to suspect EdgeDesk’s inputs: EdgeDesk’s published number sits 12.5 points from the middle of its own other models. Treat the gap as an open research question, not as an edge.
supporting: When Texas has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Texas’ offense has allowed a sack on 8.7% of its dropbacks, and Ole Miss’ defense sacks the quarterback on 4.8% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Texas has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Texas’ offense is stopped at or behind the line on 18.5% of its runs, and Ole Miss’ defense stops 23.9% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).

When Texas has the ball (big plays on the ground): Texas’ offense turns 3.4% of its runs into explosive gains, and Ole Miss’ defense gives up explosive gains on 4.8% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Ole Miss’ offensive line No. 33 nationally and Texas’ No. 77.
contradicting: When Ole Miss has the ball (big plays through the air): Ole Miss’ offense turns 8.7% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Texas’ defense gives up explosive gains on 4.2% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).
When Ole Miss has the ball (the passing game against the pass defense): Ole Miss’ offense averages 7.8 yards per pass attempt, and Texas’ defense allows 5.5 yards per pass attempt (FBS average 7.4).
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Texas’ secondary No. 2 nationally and Ole Miss’ No. 89.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Texas’ pass defense No. 1 nationally and Ole Miss’ No. 57.
quarterbacks: Arch Manning has completed 107 of 170 passes (62.9%) for 1,298 yards, 7.6 yards per attempt, 11 touchdowns and 5 interceptions in six games for Texas, and has been sacked on 17 of 187 dropbacks.

Trinidad Chambliss has completed 143 of 212 passes (67.5%) for 1,676 yards, 7.9 yards per attempt, 14 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in six games for Ole Miss, and has been sacked on 5 of 217 dropbacks.
